description: Phase-52 RESEARCH-ONLY native-ETH sink extension for the omitted_term / computed_unapplied dataflow lane. Read ONLY by scripts/native_eth_sink_gate.py (un-wired). Runs AFTER the P47 dataflow gate and the P49 bound guard, only on omitted_term/computed_unapplied candidates whose pre-decision is ADVANCE/REVIEW_ONLY. It can ONLY demote (ADVANCE->REVIEW_ONLY/ABSTAIN, REVIEW_ONLY->ABSTAIN) and never promotes. It repairs the P51 gap: P47 recognizes ERC20-style sinks but not native-ETH value transfers. A computed term is APPLIED (so the omitted/computed candidate is demoted) when it (or a derived alias) is the amount of a native-ETH value transfer: low-level .call{value: x}, 1-arg .transfer(x), or 1-arg .send(x). Generic only — NO subject identifiers. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].
